response.sql: WITH acct AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, t.account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS avg_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3, t.account_id), region_avg AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amount) AS avg_amount, AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_balance FROM acct GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_amount FROM region_avg) SELECT r.region, r.avg_amount, r.avg_balance, r.avg_amount / o.mean_amount AS amount_ratio FROM region_avg r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_amount IS NOT NULL AND o.mean_amount <> 0
